Trusted With Stakeholders: You’ve worked directly with tax agents, corporate secretarial providers and non-finance colleagues. Jump over to our LinkedIn page to get a feel for how we work, the culture we’re proud of, and the products we’re building together. Strong adaptability and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage changing customer and business requirements.
